ben-ml: quick dump from the cross-region bench run — comparing Llama / Mistral / Qwen on H100 (eu-west1), A100 (us-west1) and MI300 (apac-sg).
I ran quant4a builds + quant4mi for Qwen and Mistral, seqlen=4096 / ctx scale tests. Observed a consistent p99 spike for Mistral quant4a in apac-sg on H100 where the runtime falls back to a slow generic GEMM kernel.

Summary (p50/p95/p99 latency ms, gen 512 tokens):
```\nModel    | region   | hw   | qtype   | p50 | p95 | p99
Mistral  | apac-sg  | H100 | quant4a  | 42  | 127 | 412
Mistral  | eu-west1 | H100 | quant4a  | 40  | 98  | 120
Qwen     | apac-sg  | H100 | quant4a  | 45  | 110 | 130
Llama    | apac-sg  | H100 | q4_0     | 38  | 95  | 115
```\n
Run command (for transparency):
```\n./bench_run --model mistral-7b --quant quant4a --seq-len 4096 --gen 512 --kernel-policy auto --region apac-sg --repeats 3 --job-id bench-1991
```\n
sara: I pulled the node logs for bench-1991. There's an explicit fallback message when kernel selector can't match a rope-phase optimized kernel due to the model's rotary/rope config. Snippet: \n```\n2026-11-02T12:34:02Z kernel_selector.cpp:827 kernel_fallback: no optimized_kernel for (arch=sm92, op=matmul_epilogue, pos_embed=rope_phase, seq>2048) -> falling back to generic_gemm
```\n
kai: hmm. that matches an earlier bug where rope_phase+quant4a mapping wasn't registered for the H100 build in that region's kernel cache. Can we verify the kernel cache hash on the apac image? also try seq-len=2048 and --ctx-cache=off to rule out KV cache interaction.

marta: note that Dedicated pools in apac use a slightly different kernel mapping table (we ship a pinned kernel manifest). Hosted nodes use dynamic selection and may hit missing precompiled kernels more often. If it's a fallback we should expect ~3-4x slower p99 tails. For capacity sizing: if we want to keep p99 <200ms for that workload in apac, allocate +20% GPUs or use the quant4mi variant which has a compatible kernel set.

ben-ml: thanks — will run fast followups: 1) seq-len=2048, ctx-cache=off; 2) quant4mi build; 3) force kernel-recompile on node (clear kernel cache and warmup). Posting when each completes.

infra-bot: deployment: bench-job bench-1991 canary started on apac-sg/h100-pool-3 (containers: r-inference:stable, kernel-reload-mode=soft).

sara: quick repro results — seq-len=2048 + ctx-cache=off reduced p99 -> 136ms (3 runs). quant4mi run also stable p99 ~118ms. forcing kernel-recompile made no difference until we pushed the correct kernel manifest (mismatch was the manifest version).

kai: action items: 1) add a manifest check in the onboarding checklist for new models (compare model pos-embed flags to kernel manifest capabilities), 2) add an automated regional kernel-sanity job in infra (weekly) that fails on fallback logs, 3) doc note for quantization onboarding: test both q4 variants and verify kernel mapping on all target regions.

marta: will update capacity playbook with +20% buffer and a fallback route to quant4mi for apac until kernel manifest rollout completes.

ben-ml: cool — i'll open a short PR with the bench logs, the failing manifest hash, and the repro commands. will tag @kai @marta for review. :thumbsup:
